title: Maple Hollow Rising Revisited
author: Astrid Quintana
blurb: Ivo Eriksen, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
